fact: Turn 12 incident between Cars 4 and 27 at 12:03.
offence: Alleged breach of Appendix L, Chapter IV, Article 2 d) of the FIA International Sporting Code.
reason: The Stewards heard from the driver of Car 4 (Lando Norris), the driver of Car 27 (Nico Hulkenberg), team representatives and reviewed video, team radio and in-car video evidence. NOR was on a consistent flying lap when he caught up with HUL, who was on an out lap, before T12. HUL stayed on the racing line when NOR overtook him on the left. Just before turning into the corner, NOR kept a straight line while HUL was just about to turn into the left-hand corner. This caused light contact between HUL's left front wheel and NOR's right rear wheel. Both drivers contributed to the contact and none of them is predominantly to blame for the incident.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
title: Decision Car 4 Alleged Contact With Car 27
